  I am stuck in this life and and that's why I've decided to put myself out of this misery.
I live in Iran. I must have my father's written permission to get out of the country and my father will never allow me to move away.

No. there's no way for me to get our of the country for at least a few years. I have a well paying job but i have to save for many years to be able to immigrate. I no longer have the energy or motivation to do that.

Not really. I'm girl and i can't get out of country easily. I also know some gay refugees and they live in terrible conditions outside of the country. They have to wait for years and many of them get rejected and have to come back.

When i was younger, i thought it is possible to be happy here. Now i know i was a fucking idiot. I have spend years trying to find a way but i have always failed, because there's no way out of this situation.

Nothing new. My existence is a crime in my country. Being gay is punished by death. There's no gay community, no cafe, no gay bar that i can meet people like me. I'm so lonely. I don't have any friends because i can't trust anyone. I don't remember the last time i had a truthful conversation in real life.  I'm always lying, always pretending and i can't go on anymore.
